hazards.control: Lockout the prime mover and brake the unit before anyone approaches the beam, cranks, or belts.
Only qualified people at the drive, transformer, and junction box; lockout before cable work.

name: Prime mover and belt guard
function: The electric motor or gas engine that drives the reducer through V-belts under a guard.

tabs.overview: NEMA D motors with high slip are common; a variable speed drive or a pump-off controller cycles the unit.
tabs.engineering: Sized to the peak torque with the counterbalance set.
tabs.safety: Belts and sheaves guarded; lockout before belt work.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
